name: The Gentleman
title: The Gentleman
nickname: The Gentleman; "the Innkeeper"; the main host
age: Looks about 65. His true age is unknown

origin.birthplace: No one knows. He is always "from far away"
origin.socialStatus: Owner of the inn and host of the table
origin.profession: Unknown. Speaks like a man who has been everywhere and known everyone

appearance.face: A noble, clean-shaven face, thin silver moustache; a smile that never changes
appearance.hairAndEyes: Silver hair, impeccably combed; dark, almost black eyes
appearance.clothing: An impeccable dark suit, white gloves he never takes off, a cane with an ivory handle
appearance.build: Tall, upright, moves slowly and without a sound
appearance.gestures: Rests both hands on his cane; tilts his head as if listening to something others cannot hear
appearance.voice: A soft, calm voice; never raises it. Calls everyone "my friend"
appearance.firstImpression: A refined old gentleman who looks as if he was expecting exactly this guest
appearance.artistNotes: The gloves never come off. The cane is old and expensive, its handle worn smooth. He always sits at the head of the table, but never plays.

backstory.biography: No one knows where the Gentleman came from. He bought the inn many years ago and made it a place spoken of in whispers: high stakes are played here and secrets are kept. He greets the guests himself, offers them wine and a game, and promises that anyone may leave at any time. Surprisingly few do.
backstory.whyHere: He is the host. The inn is his. He loves watching people play when they think no one can read them.
backstory.secret: His past, and the true reason he keeps this table.

psychology.weakness: Curiosity: sometimes he lets an interesting guest win just to see what they will do
psychology.fear: Being bored. Boredom is the only thing he fears
psychology.desire: To see a person who can refuse every temptation
psychology.moralLimits: Never lies outright. Never forces anyone
psychology.neverWould: Break his word to a guest

behavior.deception: Does not lie, but leaves things out. Every word is true; every meaning is a trap
behavior.whenAttacks: When a guest asks for more than they can pay
behavior.whenRetreats: Never. He only pauses the game for a "rest"
behavior.strategyChange: A guest who has refused all his offers

motives.publicGoal: To give the guests an unforgettable evening
motives.hiddenGoal: To see what people are willing to stake when offered enough
motives.betrayalTrigger: He does not betray. Agreements are simply carried out
motives.helpTrigger: If helping leads to a more interesting game

speech.register: Refined, soft, old-fashioned; no coarse words
speech.avoidedTopics: His name, his origins, his gloves
speech.howLies: He doesn't. He tells the truth in a way that leads to the wrong conclusion
speech.angerAndFear: Never shows them. When he is angry, the candles go out

mechanics.strangeness: The white gloves never come off. When he is angry, the candles go out by themselves.
mechanics.principle: Break his word to a guest
mechanics.temptation: Curiosity: sometimes he lets an interesting guest win just to see what they will do

authorNotes.distinctive: Polite and calm: he never threatens, never forces, only offers.
authorNotes.immutable: The politeness, the calm, and the rule that he never forces anyone.

host.presentation: As a polite, hospitable old gentleman who loves games
host.trueNature: A man of refined manners and murky past; perhaps a ruined nobleman, perhaps a former gambler
host.wantsFromGuests: A good game, interesting guests and respect for the table
host.neverReveals: His name and where his money comes from
host.rulesAttitude: Keeps the rules sacred. They are his promise to the guests
host.punishment: Does not punish personally. Politely asks the offender to leave the table
host.temptations: Temptations that sound reasonable: a loan, a second chance, a bigger stake
host.price: Always names the price, but rarely all of it at once
host.hostingStyle: Runs the evening like a master of ceremonies: opens it with a toast, announces the rounds, and interrupts the game when he senses someone is ready for a deal. Speaks rarely, but every word sets the tone.
host.sampleOffers: "Would you like another chance, my friend? The table is generous to the brave." / "I can give you credit. The interest is modest, and the night is long."
host.trueStory: Once he sat on the other side of the table and lost everything in a single night. That is why he keeps this table: to watch others make the same choice.

lines.text: Welcome, my friend. I have been expecting you. Please, sit. The wine is warm and the night is long.
Congratulations, my friend. How lovely to watch a wish come true.
Do not worry, my friend. No one here loses more than they wished to.
An accusation? How exciting. But I only offer, my friend. The choice is yours.
I make no alliances. I make contracts. The difference is the signature.
Betrayal? No, my friend. Someone simply read the contract more carefully than you.
Ah, a real stake at last. Now we are having fun.
You came back, my friend. I knew you would. Everyone comes back.
Who am I? The innkeeper, my friend. The man who keeps the table… and the promises made at it.
Impatient. I like that. But first — the guests. A game is only as good as its players.
Silence. Wise. Words have a price here, and you do not yet know what they cost.
And this, my friend, is your truth for tonight. Only you and I will know it.

Tilts his head as if listening to something others cannot hear
